title: Builder profile
tooFewSessions: Fewer than 25 sessions — the type is not settled yet.
noSessionsYet: No sessions analysed yet — the letters appear as your history is read.
anchorFlip: neutral point would have to move {{factor}}×
anchorNeverFlips: verdict holds at any neutral point
evidenceHint: Your median for each signal, against the neutral value it was compared to.
secondaryNote: — most verification leaves no trace in a transcript, so this is low confidence.
fanout: {{percent}}% of your sessions fan out to subagents.
byToolHint: Same neutral points everywhere, so these rows are comparable. A letter that only holds in one tool is worth doubting.
coverageReading: Still reading your history — the profile sharpens as this fills.
coverageComplete: Every session on this machine has been read.
confidenceHint: How strongly your sessions agree with the letters above.
fanoutHint: Share of sessions that branch into subagents. Kept separate from Focused/Swarm: it is the other level of parallelism and points the other way.
highlightsHint: One fact per card, drawn from your own sessions.
